title: Board View column header shows grip, avatar, name, pin and count as designed
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View, Work orders > Create & Edit and See financial data, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is 1440 px wide, with the browser zoom at 100%.
  • The design pictures DC-10-board-column-headers-light-1440.png and DC-10-board-pinned-light-1440.png are open beside the app at 100% zoom (actual size); they are attached to this case.
  • In the design pictures the names, numbers, dates and amounts are sample data, and the rank numbers (1, 2, 3 …) beside rows and cards are left out of this release, so do not compare those.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC10 Lea Pin) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has a profile photo.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC10 Max Pin) is an active technician at {Location-A} who has no profile photo.
  • Technician {Technician-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC10 Nia Pin) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Technician {Technician-D} (for example ZZAUTOTEST DC10 Oli Pin) is an active technician at {Location-A}.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST DC10 Column Header") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17827) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-A}.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17828) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-B}.
  • Estimate {Work-order-3} (for example S10043-17829) for {Customer-A} has no lead technician, so it sits in the Unassigned column.
  • No technician is pinned in your Board View.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter (if the Asset on Site chip shows Yes or No, click the x on the chip), Assigned to me is off, Search is empty and density is Regular (the default).
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher.
  2. Look at the Unassigned column header from left to right.
  3. Look at {Technician-B}'s column header from left to right.
  4. Look at the avatar in {Technician-A}'s column header.
  5. Click the pin icon in {Technician-B}'s column header.
  6. Look at the pin icon in {Technician-B}'s column header.
  7. Click the pin icon in {Technician-A}'s column header.
  8. Click the pin icon in {Technician-C}'s column header.
  9. Hover the pin icon in {Technician-D}'s column header.
  10. Click the pin icons of {Technician-B}, {Technician-A} and {Technician-C} to unpin them.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: a round light-grey avatar with a grey outline person icon, the word Unassigned in dark semibold text, a short grey divider, a clipboard outline icon and the number of work orders. The Unassigned header has no grip and no pin, as in the design picture.
  • Step 3: the six-dot grip, a light-grey circle with the initials in dark grey (not a solid blue circle with white initials), the name in dark semibold text, a grey outline pin icon, a short divider, the clipboard icon and the number, as in the design picture.
  • Step 4: {Technician-A}'s avatar is the round photo.
  • Step 6: the icon is now a pin with a slash through it, in blue, as on the pinned columns in the pinned design picture.
  • Step 9: the pin icons on the columns that are not pinned look faded and the hover text reads "You can pin up to 3 technicians."
  • Step 10: every technician column header shows the grey outline pin again.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View), SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 54 (15 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R12, S3-R7, S3-R8 and S1-R9a, read 15 Oct 2026; Claude Design project "Work Orders" (Branko Cicovic), export of 14 Oct 2026, board "Work Orders.dc.html", states core__work-orders__board-detailed__light__1440 and states__work-orders__board-pinned-two__light__1440 (design pictures DC-10-board-column-headers-light-1440.png, DC-10-board-pinned-light-1440.png, rendered from that export at the width in the name), read 14 Oct 2026. Covers the design defects SV-11319 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Chris Ward), SV-11338 (reported 14 Oct 2026 by Ahtasham Amjad). Where the PRD says nothing about the look, the design is the source. Source-verified 15 October 2026. Last checked against build v26.40.17-a5c4210 (staging) on 10/15/2026.

SV-11338 estimates the design's header name at about 16 px; the ticket's estimated design sizes differ from the design file, which draws the name at 14 px semibold; this case follows the design file. The design allows five pins; this case follows the PRD's limit of three.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R12: “Each column header shows the technician’s name, avatar, and a count of the work orders currently shown in that column, after the filter view and filters are applied, so the count always matches the cards listed.”
  • S3-R7: “Allow users to pin a technician from the column header.”
  • S3-R8: “At three pinned technicians, disable other pin controls with: “You can pin up to 3 technicians.””
  • S1-R9a: “The switcher uses the design’s icons at 20px: List is Lucide `list`, Tech View is `user-round`, Board View is `square-kanban`. In Tech View and Board View these icons are the design’s: density (`row-height` in Tech View, `card-height` in Board View, custom icons in the design system’s icon set), collapse chevron (`chevron-down`), pin and unpin (`pin` / `pin-off`), Invoiced or Paid lock (`lock`), Unassigned avatar (`user-round`) and the empty state when there are no work orders at all (`clipboard-list`). The filtered no-results state is the List’s, magnifier included (S1-N1). The filter chips and Search use the design file’s icons in every display option, List included, each exactly as the design file draws it; this is the only change to List. Every other List icon is unchanged.”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View Unassigned avatar: “width: 28px; height: 28px; flex: none; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--sv-surface-sunken); color: var(--sv-text-secondary);”
  • Design — Work Orders.dc.html, Board View column header name: “font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--sv-text-primary); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; margin-right: -8px;”
  • Design — _ds_bundle.js (design library), staff avatar without a photo: “background: color || 'var(--sv-surface-sunken)', color: color ? 'var(--sv-accent-on-solid)' : 'var(--sv-text-secondary)',”
